== Summary ==

:{{pov|[[Siuan Sanche]]}}
Siuan tries to help with [[Healing]] after escaping the [[Sharan]] attack and is sent away by [[Yukiri Haruna|Yukiri]] due to Siuan’s exhaustion. Siuan orders [[Haerm]] to search for the [[Egwene al'Vere|Amyrlin]], convinced that she has survived the ambush. Pieces of the army have survived with the help of [[gateways]] from the [[Aes Sedai]] while the Sharans were busy attacking the camp. Yukiri had kept her head during the attack and ordered the others to jump through a gateway she created in the ground, saving the lives of everyone in the Command tent. 

[[Gareth Bryne]] and Siuan discuss the losses, one out of every two men, after the last attack and 120 dead Aes Sedai, along with their [[Warder|Warders]]. Bryne is upset that he made a mistake in not attacking the [[Trolloc|Trollocs]] sooner and being too careful. He realizes that the [[Shadowspawn]]'s behavior indicated that an ambush was coming, and he missed the signs. He says that he was trained better than this and he could not ignore this mistake.

:{{pov|[[Lyrelle Arienwin]]}}
Lyrelle is in charge of the remaining sisters set to watch the Black Tower by Egwene. They have faced multiple [[Bubble of evil|bubbles of evil]] and even [[Darkfriend|Darkfriends]] trying to kill them all. They have been advised [[Mazrim Taim|Taim]] is no longer at the tower and they are now free to enter. They enter the tower to bond the [[Asha'man|Asha’man]] they were promised. 

[[Pevara Tazanovni|Pevara]] joins their group at [[Logain Ablar|Logain]]’s request. Pevara explains that bonding Asha’man does not compel them as is possible with ordinary men. Lyrelle insists on going through with bonding them. 

:{{pov|[[Androl Genhald]]}}
Androl provides the Tower Aes Sedai camped outside the Black Tower with 46 men who volunteered to be [[Warder|Warders]], as he has already been bonded by Pevara. He tells Lyrelle they may bond any men they can ask. All of the other Asha’man are away on other business, and Androl has hidden [[Jonneth Dowtry|Jonneth]], [[Algarin Pendaloan|Emarin]], and [[Taril Canler|Canler]]. Lyrelle instructs the Aes Sedai to select their Warders. 

Androl slips into one of the huts and Pevara follows. Logain has been poring over the things they found in [[Mazrim Taim|Taim's]] rooms. He is darker, talks less, and Pevara worries that the Turning has broken him inside. Androl states that they follow Logain's orders, because Logain gave them hope, and that they'll honor the [[Rand al'Thor|Dragon’s]] last order to think of themselves not as weapons, but as men.
